$description: Third-party skills installed into .claude/skills, pinned to the reviewed commit. See .claude/skills-architecture.md.
method: Shallow clone to a scratch dir, manual review, selective file copy. No install scripts run, no package installs, no hooks, MCP servers or permissions added.
checks: repo owner/org, commit history, recency, license
every file inventoried; all executable code read
grep for curl/wget, base64/eval/Function, child_process, rm -rf, install scripts, env/secret access, external hosts, permission-bypass or prompt-override text
no package.json, lockfile, hooks, .mcp.json or settings copied

excluded.axe-accessibility (Deque): Needs a paid Axe DevTools subscription. Its MCP server runs unpinned `npx -y` packages on every start with the full shell environment. The project already runs axe-core via @axe-core/playwright.
excluded.Design plugin MCP servers: Slack/Figma/Linear/Asana/Atlassian/Notion/Intercom/Gmail/Calendar connectors are not needed for this site. The skills were taken without them.
excluded.cuellarfr/design-skills: Clean, but duplicates impeccable + Anthropic design; design-elevation steers toward the Stripe/Linear look.
excluded.VectorLab (all except anti-slop): App-UI rules. Its motion skill (100-300ms only, CSS-first, no ambient loops) conflicts with the cinematic brief.
excluded.impeccable scripts/hooks/agents: The launcher downloads and executes a native binary; the hooks run it on every edit.
excluded.freshtechbro/claudedesignskills: Last commit Nov 2025, single author, ships opaque .zip bundles and generator scripts. Superseded by official GSAP/LottieFiles skills and CloudAI-X Three.js. Its barba.js skill conflicts with Astro routing.
excluded.gsap-react, gsap-frameworks, react-three: React/Vue specific; the project is Astro without React.
excluded.vercel-labs web-design-guidelines: Fetches rules from a remote URL at runtime; overlaps impeccable audit + web-quality.
excluded.Lenis community skills: No official skill (Darkroom's cc-settings has none); community ones are React/Next-centric. Covered by the GSAP ScrollTrigger guidance.
excluded.theonlym7md arabicskill: Larger Saudi govtech-oriented companion; arabic-uiux-master covers this site's needs.
